source.source_locator: 教則 第5章 5.1.2(2)「飛行中の監視」（教則表示ページ54 / PDF viewer 60）

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 飛行中は機体状態・計画どおりの飛行状態・気象変化・周囲の航空機等・第三者を継続監視する。
evidence.tested_misconception: 飛行前確認が済んでいれば飛行中は機体異常だけ見ればよい。
evidence.reasoning_path: in-flight phase -> multiple dynamic hazards -> continuous monitoring set

collision.note: LOW。Q080/Q081は飛行開始前、Q039は運航終了後。飛行中の監視項目セットは未出。

independent_review.rationale: 5.1.2 explicitly requires continuous in-flight monitoring of ownship condition and planned route/altitude/speed, weather changes, aircraft/other UAS, and third parties. This general operational monitoring set is distinct from existing no-assistant BVLOS telemetry requirements.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review is source-consistent with the current MLIT 第5版 Chapter 5, preserves second-class scope, and correctly isolates one semantic duplicate. The other 19 candidates test distinct operational process, insurance/security, GNSS-off control, aircraft-specific takeoff/landing technique, human-error mitigation, CRM-skill, and assistant-role propositions with useful practice value. Near-neighbor candidates C004, C012, C014 and C020 remain distinct from the cited canonical questions because they require different causal or operational decision boundaries.
